description: This file defines a generic serializer class for value types in the Orleans serialization framework, implementing methods to serialize and deserialize value types with support for custom serializers.

classes.name: ValueSerializer
classes.description: A generic serializer class for value types, parameterized by the field type and the serializer implementation, providing methods to write and read value fields.

methods.name: ValueSerializer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer with a specific value serializer implementation.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value of type TField into the writer, marking the value as a value field and writing the object start and end markers.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value of type TField from the reader, marking the value as a value field and invoking the serializer's deserialize method.
